How to read this

Left of the slider handle is the earlier month, right is the later one. A pixel counts as changed when its colour differs by at least 30/255 (largest RGB channel, 3×3 smoothed, after removing the box-wide brightness shift), ignoring cloud-like and no-data pixels. A month is flagged when at least 5% of the valid pixels changed against the previous usable clip and that is at least 1.5× this place's typical month-to-month change (41.2% here). Sentinel-2 pixels are 10 m: this finds large construction, clearing, new roofs or paving and big ground changes. It cannot see objects a few pixels wide, so it says nothing about a pool, a shed or a fence. Crops, trees, water level, snow and shadows change the colour too: a flag is a prompt to look, not proof of a building change.
